RedRock is an unofficial, personal project.

It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Microsoft, Mojang Studios, Xbox, Google, Meta, or any of their subsidiaries.

Minecraft® is a trademark of Mojang Synergies AB / Microsoft. Google Play™ and Android are trademarks of Google LLC. Meta Quest® and Horizon OS are trademarks of Meta Platforms, Inc.

RedRock only downloads apps the signed-in Google account already owns, for personal use on this user’s devices. It does not sell, host, or redistribute APKs. Play may refuse a download. That is not a bypass.

Use at your own risk.

RedRock is a Quest window for Minecraft you already own.

It is unofficial and open source (BSD 3-Clause). It is not a Store copy, not a cracked APK, and not affiliated with Mojang, Google, or Meta.

This window is the library. Play fills the same 2D window. It does not dump you into stereo VR yet.

You must own Minecraft on Google Play. RedRock asks Play for that copy and hosts it inside RedRock. It does not install Minecraft as a second Quest app.

Longer docs live on GitHub: github.com/Bit-Byte5/RedRock (public). Do not put tokens, passwords, or APKs in that repo.

Left sidebar is the main chrome. Press a tab — it lifts toward you when it is selected.

• Grass block — Game (hero cube only)
• Toolbox — native mods
• Books — these docs
• Computer — live log
• Sliders — Settings (Google + mixer)
• Unofficial — disclaimer

Bottom bar: Minecraft version chip and Play. Tap the version for Latest (Play’s current build) or a listed Bedrock release.

If Minecraft is not extracted yet, Play says Download. After a good download it says Play.

The Game tab is the grass block. The big cube is just the hero. Download and Play live on the bottom bar, not on the cube.\n\nStay on this tab while a download runs if you want to watch the bar. You can still open Docs or Settings; do not start another download until the current one finishes.

Download talks to Google Play as the signed-in account.

1. Settings → Google. Confirm it is the account that owns Minecraft.
2. Pick Latest or a listed version on the bottom chip.
3. Press Download. If you are signed out, Google’s login page opens here. RedRock never reads your password — only a one-time login cookie, stored on this headset.
4. Play must allow it. If it refuses, you do not own it, the region blocks it, or Play said no. That is not a bypass.

No APKPure. No mirrors. No friend’s dump. Quest needs arm64-v8a. A Mac mcpelauncher x86 extract will not run here.

Files unpack into RedRock private storage, not a second Minecraft icon.

When the button says Play, RedRock checks the extracted game (preflight), then starts Minecraft’s MainActivity in this same 2D window.

If it still says Download, the game is not on disk. If it says the game is not ready, preflight failed — open the Log tab. Native crashes cannot be caught, so RedRock refuses to start a bad payload.

Leave with B from the hosted menu, or the library Leave control when you are back in RedRock chrome.

Stereo OpenXR is later. VRed on the mods tab is an empty scaffold.

Library window:
• Laser pointer + trigger to click
• Quest keyboard on Google sign-in — tap a field if it does not appear

Hosted game menu:
• Point + trigger, or A to confirm
• Stick up / down to move the highlight
• B to leave

Look and Volume are Settings → Mixer. They are local to this window. They are not written into Minecraft yet.

Two pages: Google (first) and Mixer.

Google is how you know Play is using the right account. Signed out: tap the card or Sign in. Signed in: you see the email. Sign out or Switch account. Sign-in from here does not start a download.

Use an account that already owns Minecraft. An unofficial Play client can violate Google’s terms. Google may ban the account. Prefer a spare account. Never sign in as someone else.

Mixer: Look and Volume only. Not saved into the game yet.

Sideloaded RedRock is not in the Store library or the bottom dock. You need Developer Mode.

1. Press the Meta button
2. Open Apps / Library
3. Left side — question-mark folder — Unknown Sources
4. RedRock

If that folder is missing: Developer Mode off and on in the phone app, reboot, sideload again from a computer (./redrock load).

USB: accept the RSA prompt. Wireless: pair port and connect port are different. Pairing code is not the connect IP.

Toolbox tab. Extra mods are mcpelauncher-style arm64 .so files. Not Fabric/Forge jars. Not marketplace packs. Not x86 Mac .so files.

RedRock Core — always on, cannot remove. Loads mod_preinit, then libminecraftpe, then mod_init.

VRed — stereo scaffold. Cannot remove, can disable. Stereo is not implemented. The toggle only loads or skips an empty stub.

Add extra mods
1. Put an arm64-v8a .so on the headset (Files / Downloads, or adb).
2. Add, pick the .so.
3. Off skips it next Play. Remove deletes it.
4. Play.

From a computer: ./redrock mods push libThatMod.so

Hooks (mcpelauncher_hook / mcpelauncher_preinithook) resolve against RedRock’s libmcpelauncher_mod.so.

Source is public: github.com/Bit-Byte5/RedRock

BSD 3-Clause: people may use the code however they want. No warranty. The authors are not responsible for bans, broken headsets, or how anyone uses a fork.

The name RedRock is not licensed. Forks must not pretend to be the official project.

Never commit Google tokens, .env, APKs, OBB, logs, or headset IPs. Issues and PRs are public too — redact secrets.

Longer pages: docs/ on GitHub (getting started, legal, architecture, CLI).

Not a Minecraft Store listing.
Not a pirate client.
Not a way to skip paying for Bedrock.
Not PackageInstaller — you should not get a second Minecraft app from Download.
Not working stereo VR yet.
Not a desktop Play downloader (./redrock fetch does not exist). Downloads run on the headset.

If Play says no, stop. Do not look for another APK site.

No device on the computer: USB prompt, or pair then connect on the right ports.

Cannot find the app: Unknown Sources, Developer Mode, reboot, sideload again.

Wrong account / does not own Minecraft: Settings → Google → switch.

Play refused: TOS / region / DRM. Not a RedRock bypass.

No arm64: Play sent the wrong ABI.

Still Download after a wait: Log tab. Look at package name and fetch state. Do not paste cookies into a public GitHub issue.

Game not ready: preflight failed. Try that version again. Do not copy a Mac mcpelauncher folder onto Quest.

Disable extra mods first if the game dies after Play.

On a Mac or Linux clone of the repo:

./redrock status
./redrock run build + sideload + launch
./redrock logs logcat into logs/ (gitignored)
./redrock mods list | push file.so | rm file.so

Need JDK 17+ and adb. Copy .env.example to .env for QUEST_HOST. Never commit .env.
